A firearm simulator is a training system that replicates real-world shooting scenarios using virtual or augmented reality, laser-based firearms, or computerized environments. These simulators provide a safe and controlled setting for users to practice marksmanship, decision-making, and tactical responses without the risks or costs associated with live ammunition. They are commonly used by military, law enforcement, and civilian firearm trainers to enhance shooting skills, improve reaction times, and refine judgment under pressure. Are simulator appointments private? Yes! Every session on our simulator is completely private. However, we also offer two, three, and four-shooter sessions, allowing you to bring friends, family, or anyone you'd like to join in the experience. What do I need to bring? Absolutely nothing! We provide everything you need, including replica firearms, holsters, belts, and more. However, if you prefer to use your own holster or battle belt, you're more than welcome to bring it. What is Judgement Training? judgment training scenarios are interactive simulations designed to improve decision-making skills related to firearm use in real-world situations. These scenarios immerse participants in realistic, controlled environments where they must rapidly assess threats, determine appropriate responses, and decide whether or not to use force. The goal is to enhance judgment, situational awareness, and responsible firearm handling under stress, reinforcing safe and lawful outcomes. Does Simshot offer Live Fire classes? YES! We offer live-fire training classes all year long! Visit our Courses page to explore our current schedule and find the perfect class for you.
